_about: Single source of truth for the agent team. Read by agents/dashboard.html (live view) and data/build_db.py (SQLite). Keep agents/README.md in sync when you change it. 'effort' (high/medium/low) is the reasoning effort tools/pipeline/cwork.zsh gives each agent.

agents.name: ball-physicist
agents.title: Ball Physicist
agents.job: Real ball flight and believable bounces on an open-source physics engine.

agents.name: court-designer
agents.title: Court Designer
agents.job: Grass, red clay and hard courts, nets and the ball's look, in detailed pixel art.

agents.name: player-artist
agents.title: Player Artist
agents.job: Detailed pixel players and rackets, drawn on the pose and the captured serve motion.

agents.name: serve-analyst
agents.title: Serve Analyst
agents.job: Turns real serve video into clean joint motion for each player, and keeps the Player Artist in sync.

agents.name: serve-controller
agents.title: Serve Controller
agents.job: Toss, power and aim in one motion from the player's view; sweet spot, spin and ace chance from skill points.
agents.contract: serve input → { toss, power, spin, target, sweetSpot }

agents.name: version-keeper
agents.title: Version Keeper
agents.job: Records every game change; publishes a version once 5+ changes build up.

agents.name: body-animator
agents.title: Body Animator
agents.job: Natural joints and movement: planted feet, lean, split-step, swings.

agents.name: controls-designer
agents.title: Controls Designer
agents.job: WASD (default), arrow keys, touch or gamepad; only the chosen setup is shown.

agents.name: start-page-builder
agents.title: Start Page Builder
agents.job: The Tennis101 title page: pick the match, surface and controls.

agents.name: guide-writer
agents.title: Guide Writer
agents.job: A short, plain 'How to play' guide that reads its keys from the controls.

agents.name: skills-coach
agents.title: Skills Coach
agents.job: Skill points (speed, agility, endurance, strength, serve, control, reflexes, net play): a constant step per point.

agents.name: locker-room-designer
agents.title: Locker Room Designer
agents.job: The locker room: pick your pro and see their body and skill points.

agents.name: pov-camera
agents.title: First-Person Camera
agents.job: Your serve through your own eyes at your pro's real eye height: toss, look up, contact.
